name: clean-folders
title: Clean Folders
description: Downloads and Desktop fill up fast - every download and every screenshot lands there. Move their contents to the Trash in one hit, or pick a single folder. Nothing is deleted permanently.
author: chomamateusz

commands.name: clean-all
commands.title: Clean All
commands.description: Move the contents of all configured folders to the Trash

commands.name: clean-folder
commands.title: Clean Folder
commands.description: Pick one of your configured folders and move its contents to the Trash
